confidence_notes: Holistic model estimate for Melbourne in AUD for the July 2026 winter window; no live menus, listings or booking pages were checked. Restaurant and coffee anchors are more reliable than accommodation, which varies widely by suburb and date. Cocktail and wine_glass were cross-checked against the beer anchor, so they are less certain. The FX value is the 15 Oct 2026 4pm reading as shown in search-result text attributed to the RBA overview page; I did not open the RBA page directly.
comparable_city_reasoning: No comparable city was used. Anchors reflect general knowledge of Melbourne CBD and inner-suburb pricing; beer is the reference used to cross-check cocktail and wine.
